result.summary: Postoperative encounter following rectocele repair with biological graft and neurostimulator generator insertion/replacement, with urinary retention and an anaphylactic reaction documented. Urine collected April 14 grew multidrug-resistant Citrobacter freundii complex; results finalized April 16 support contact precautions. No invasive respiratory support, active IV drips, vascular lines, or tubes are documented.
result.contact_isolation_reason: April 14 urine culture, finalized April 16, grew Citrobacter freundii complex resistant to ceftriaxone/ceftazidime, gentamicin, and trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole, supporting contact precautions for a multidrug-resistant organism. MRSA screen was negative.
